The Cambrian ( / ˈ k æ m b r i . ə n , ˈ k eɪ m -/ KAM -bree-ən, KAYM - ) is the first geological period of the Paleozoic Era and the Phanerozoic Eon . [ 5 ] The Cambrian lasted 51.95 million years from the end of the preceding Ediacaran period 538.8 Ma (million years ago) to the beginning of the Ordovician Period 486.85 Ma. [ 1 ]
